programmes.d: When the son of Frank's most outspoken critic in the African-American community, Reverend Darnell Potter (Ato Essandoh), is killed, Potter must put aside his contentious relationship with the Reagan family to get justice for his son.
When Eddie and Jamie become overly involved in a complicated adoption case between the birth and adoptive parents, they ask Erin to help them settle the dispute without going to court.
When Danny accepts a side job as a bodyguard for a recently released ex-con who took the fall for someone else, he uses the opportunity to go after the real criminal.
When diplomatic immunity complicates a child abuse case for Danny and Baez, Frank intervenes, despite not having jurisdiction on the case.
While investigating the murder of a gang leader, Danny and Baez learn the accused shooter is an ex-con who is romantically linked to his parole officer, who might be assisting in a cover up.

While investigating the murder of a man who killed a mother and son years earlier while driving drunk, Danny and Baez are torn between doing their job and finding justice after discovering the connection between the suspect and the victim.
When Linda's brother, Jimmy (Kevin Dillon), gets into trouble with the mob, he begs Danny to help him stay safe until it blows over.

Jamie and Eddie suspect foul play when they respond to a distress call from a woman having an allergic reaction to her lifesaving medication, and learn that her husband is an EMT assigned to take her call, but didn't respond.

Danny investigates the circumstances of an ex-NYPD officer who goes missing the day after she revealed to him that she had planned to make amends to the woman she and her partner wrongfully convicted years ago.

Erin faces off in court against her ex-husband, Jack (Peter Hermann), who is representing the person she is attempting to convict of murder. Also, Danny and Baez investigate to see if the husband is behind the murder of his wife.

After Reggie Wilson (Cyrus Farmer), a witness in a former case of Erin's, asks her for help shutting down a drug operation in his apartment building, she makes it her mission to make the building safe for his family.
Danny and Baez team up with two Russian operatives to search for a dangerous Russian man who entered the U.S. on a diplomatic visa.
When Danny intercepts a shipment of several million dollars that was heading to a drug cartel in Mexico, he becomes a target when they come back for revenge.

After a young girl goes missing, the family argues whether Danny used questionable methods in order to bring her home safely. Meanwhile, Jamie graduates from the police academy and begins his new life as a cop, on the series premiere.
A good Samaritan who takes action against a criminal terrorizing the subway has the Reagans pondering the rights and wrongs of vigilantism.
With a bomb set to detonate in Manhattan, Frank, Danny, and the rest of the NYPD search for its whereabouts. In the midst of the search, the Reagans argue the merits and downfalls of profiling.
Erin's family debates her methods when she uses a law-abiding citizen as bait to take down his gang leader brother.
Erin, Frank, and Danny work together within the system to find justice when a rape case's primary suspect is protected by diplomatic immunity.
Frank mobilizes the entire NYPD to find the killer of an off-duty police officer who was murdered during a diamond heist.

Danny works to discover the source of a deadly narcotic after three teenagers die from a drug overdose.
After witnessing a crime in progress, Jamie's suspect is killed in the pursuit. Danny must solve the case to clear Jamie's name and keep IA from a full-blown investigation.
Three released prison inmates place the Reagan family in danger.
While Danny investigates the murder of a popular nightclub's doorman, Frank gets information that his ex-partner is covering up crimes.
A 25-year-old cold case of Frank's is brought to the forefront when the missing boy's remains are found. Danny and Jackie look into the death of a high-end escort.
Because it involves classified information and a sleeper cell, Frank assigns Danny to cover the shooting of an undercover counter-terrorism agent.
